directions.title: Architectural A
directions.prompt:
Use case: text-localization. Edit the supplied logo concept presentation to correct the business name. The correct complete name is "AVANTIX LABS". AVANTIX is seven letters, spelled A V A N T I X. There is NO R in AVANTIX. LABS is spelled L A B S. Replace EVERY occurrence of the old wordmark "AVANTRIX" across the primary logo, reversed logo, and bronze mockup with the correct "AVANTIX LABS" lockup.
Preserve the supplied Architectural A symbol exactly, its line geometry, the same layout and image proportions, elegant serif wordmark style, warm ivory #F3F0E8, espresso #191814, bronze #8A4B2A, limestone stone texture, material treatments, favicon and all surrounding negative space.
Typography hierarchy: "AVANTIX" in large editorial uppercase serif lettering. Put "LABS" as a clearly readable smaller uppercase sans-serif line beneath AVANTIX, with refined tracking and intentional spacing. In horizontal lockups, center LABS below the wordmark rather than below the icon; in centered stacked lockups, center both text lines. LABS must remain clearly readable, not microscopic. Rebalance the shorter AVANTIX wordmark optically without stretching the letters. In the bronze mockup, reproduce the same name hierarchy with the existing believable bronze finish. Preserve the symbol-only favicon; it does not need the full name.
Exact words permitted: "AVANTIX" and "LABS". No old name, no invented tagline, no extra text. Do not redesign the icon or introduce decorations. Return one refined corrected presentation board.
